name: pleiades
description: Pleiades — the real-time news terminal. Agentic news discovery, curation, and delivery infrastructure.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pleiades/contracts && npm run build -w @pleiades/db && npm run build -w @pleiades/sdk && npm run build -w pleiades-api && npm run build -w pleiades-worker && npm run build -w pleiades-bots && npm run build -w pleiades-web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @pleiades/contracts && npm run build -w @pleiades/db && npm run build -w @pleiades/sdk
scripts.test: npm run build -w @pleiades/contracts && npm run build -w pleiades-worker && node --test packages/contracts/dist/*.test.js apps/worker/dist/*.test.js
